tagline: Exact enchanting-table odds for all three slots
description: Submitted on behalf of the maker: Minecraft Enchantment Calculator is a free browser tool for vanilla Minecraft Java Edition 26.3 Survival players. Compare exact enchanting-table probabilities before spending experience and lapis, then plan lower-cost anvil combining orders for fresh or previously worked gear. The site documents its calculation rules and supported scope. No account or upload is required. Independent and unofficial; not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
features: Exact enchanting-table odds for all three slots
Anvil order planning for fresh or previously worked gear
Calculations run in the browser without an account
